title.narrative: DIBE 2025 - BrainCapture - Scaling EEG Access in Nigeria

description.narrative: The purpose of this project is to expand access to life-saving neurological diagnostics in Nigeria by deploying BrainCapture’s BC-1 device, a low-cost, portable, and medical-grade electroencephalogram (EEG) solution, across under-resourced hospitals and clinics. The project is expected to provide a significant and measurable improvement in access to neurodiagnostic services among underserved communities, particularly those previously excluded due to high costs or the absence of neurology specialists; reduction in the time to diagnosis for epilepsy and related conditions; increased provider capacity to manage neurological disorders; improved health outcomes for patients and reduced expenditure for families affected by epilepsy and other neurological conditions; and a scalable model for sustainable expansion of the B-1 solution West Africa.
